name: BN6's MegaMan's Beast Out gate
why: BN6's battle start writes 1 into both sides' players' AI data +0xF (0x08009338: 0x0800936E, 0x0800937E); it is read only by Beast Out's: its end (0x080159C6, BN6_TURN_END's call: 0 there sets 2, then the Beast Out counter, NaviStats +0x29) and its count-down (0x08015A16 for both sides, while NaviStats +0x29 is 0: one less to 0, 0xFF left). BN4 has no Beast Out, and no byte of its MegaMan's AI data its code reads so
